katie (AE): Quick heads-up — Arcadia Health wants a 10-day hands-on POC. Main ask: run our diagnostics against 3k anonymized patient notes, evaluate intent extraction + redaction, and verify deployment options. Can SE + security confirm scope? 

 dave (SE): Happy to scope. Two paths: 1) Hosted sandbox with enforced scrubbing before ingest, 2) Customer-hosted private namespace (VPC peering). For PHI we'll prefer private or fully sanitized dataset. Need schema sample and nominal QPS. 

 jamie (CS): They plan to provide 3 CSV files (notes, metadata, event logs). They said direct identifiers removed but DOBs and zip codes remain. They asked if we can hash IDs instead of storing raw values. 

 omar (Security): Important: Arcadia requires logging to their SIEM via syslog, HSM-backed key wraps, and we must provide a completed security questionnaire. If DOBs present we treat as sensitive and recommend truncation (year only) or bucketing. Also require IP allowlist for any temporary endpoints. 

 katie (AE): Pricing: they asked if we can offer a short trial credit and clarify data egress charges. Prefer usage-only. 

 dave (SE): For the POC we can provide hosted credits covering model tokens and ephemeral infra. Egress billed per standard plan; for short POC it's negligible. If they want VPC we need a 2-3 week lead and commit. 

 jamie (CS): Success criteria (customer-provided): 1) intent extraction F1 >= 0.9 on labeled subset, 2) redaction false-negative rate < 0.01 (no identifier leaks), 3) average end-to-end latency < 300ms at 50 RPS, 4) reproducible eval report and handoff doc. 

 omar (Security): To move forward on SQ we need: contact in their InfoSec, a sanitized schema sample, confirmation of whether logs can contain hashes only, and the intended retention period. We'll supply SOC2 link and KMS integration brief. Recommend retention = 7 days for POC artifacts and auto-delete. 

 katie (AE): Action plan: Dave -> provide ingestion/redaction pipeline + sample scripts. Omar -> assemble SQ response and SOC2 link. Jamie -> request sanitized files, K-anonymity check, labeled eval set. I'll draft commercial note with trial credit. 

 dave (SE): Proposed redaction approach: client-side hashing for stable IDs (sha256), DOB bucketing to year, regex scrub for emails/phones. Example python snippet we can send them: 

 ```python
 import re, hashlib
 def redact_row(row):
     row['email'] = re.sub(r'[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}', '<EMAIL_REDACTED>', row.get('email',''))
     row['phone'] = re.sub(r'(?:\+?\d{1,3}[ \ -])?(?:\(?\d{3}\)?[ \ -]?)?\d{3}[ \ -]?\d{4}', '<PHONE_REDACTED>', row.get('phone',''))
     if 'patient_id' in row:
         row['patient_id_hashed'] = hashlib.sha256(row['patient_id'].encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
         del row['patient_id']
     if 'dob' in row:
         row['dob_year'] = row['dob'][:4]
         del row['dob']
     return row
 ```

 dave (SE): Ingest options: (A) customer uploads sanitized CSV to their S3 and gives us a presigned GET; (B) we create a short-lived staging bucket in our sandbox account and they upload via presigned PUT; (C) cross-account role we assume to fetch. If they want to keep data in their VPC we can do Private deployment. 

 dave (SE): Example presign flow (AWS CLI): 
 ```bash
 aws s3 presign s3://arcadia-poc-sandbox/inputs.csv --expires-in 3600
 ```

 omar (Security): Data residency request: Arcadia requires data remain in us-east-1. We will pin the sandbox region and record that in the runbook. Also ask them to provide IPs to allowlist; we'll provide temporary ingress IPs for our workers. 

 jamie (CS): Timeline suggestion: Day 0-1: NDAs & SQ exchange. Day 2-3: sanitized sample + redaction verification. Day 4-6: infra + ingest. Day 7-9: evaluations & tuning. Day 10: final report + wrap + next steps. 

 katie (AE): I'll propose 10-day hosted POC with a $0 trial credit for infra up to X usage and option to convert to Dedicated with a two-week minimum. Will share draft pricing. 

 deploy-bot: note: sandbox instance arcadia-poc-19760 provisioning started - eta 2h

 dave (SE): I'm volunteering to run the eval harness and produce the metrics dashboard. Please cc me on the sanitized upload when ready. 

 jamie (CS): I'll request the labeled eval CSV and the list of fields they consider immutable. Planning to ask for the first sample by EOD tomorrow. 

 katie (AE): Thanks team. I'll post the POC checklist and pricing language in this thread once it's ready.
